nine-dragon-stack/1-A.note: The carved stone rail and lotus posts on the left render as a flat dark-blue mass. Hands (NR1), floor tiles and reflections match.

nine-dragon-stack/4-D.note: Floor, crowd, gate and tree match; the crowd and rain move between visits.

pine-hollow/1-gate.note: The near pine is a fuller tree than LEGACY's thin one; far trees are real now (a3050f9d2c).

pine-hollow/2-cabin.note: The boss bar is gameplay state (Old Ironhide had aggroed in LEGACY), not a look change.

pine-hollow/3-pond.note: The wooden prop in the right foreground and the snow patch by the pond are missing; a canoe sits where the snow was.

pine-hollow/4-spawn-opposite.note: Matches the golden now that the LUT is gone (G854).

driftwood-isle/1-pier.note: Clouds and planks are the accepted G855 look.

driftwood-isle/3-wreck.note: Minor: the held sword casts no shadow on the sand.

far-reach/1-spawn.note: The meadow is flat olive grass: LEGACY's white flower specks and darker clumps are gone (likely the same thin sward as R4).

far-reach/2-hover.note: The red glow and the flyer at the top are a live creature.

far-reach/3-windmill.note: Same flat meadow as camera 1: no flower specks, uniform olive grass.

far-reach/4-roost.note: Same flat meadow: no flower specks; the near grass is uniform olive. The windmill blades turn between visits.

nalati-grasslands/3-plains.note: The tall grass sways between visits, which is most of the SSIM gap.

nalati-grasslands/4-spawn-opposite.note: Minor: a row of small dark stones edges the path toward the barrier.
